title: Wallet
description: Your organization's money on MissionHub: balance, commissions per placement, withdrawals and activity. Payments land as pending and become available once they clear.

frozen.title: Outgoing movements are paused
frozen.description: The platform team paused transfers and withdrawals for this wallet. You can still receive funds. Contact support for details.

empty.title: No wallet activity yet
empty.description: When a partner pays a commission through MissionHub, it will appear here.

payouts.title: Withdrawals
payouts.notSetUp: Connect a bank account to withdraw your available balance. Identity and bank details are collected by our payment provider, not by MissionHub.
payouts.incomplete: Your payout account isn't verified yet. Finish the provider's onboarding, or wait a moment if you just did.
payouts.disabled: Withdrawals aren't open yet. Your balance is safe and will be withdrawable once they are.
payouts.requested: Withdrawal requested. You'll be notified when it's sent.

placements.title: Placements
placements.description: Commission per hire. Amounts are estimates until the client pays.
